name: Target Williamsport
address: 170 S Lycoming Mall Rd, Muncy, PA 17756
notes: Stocked by Excell Marketing: Excell's merchandiser job for this route lists this store's address (posted Jun 5 2026, still open, so the route may be short-staffed). Excell reps visit each store about once a week, on a weekday between 6am and 6pm, on a schedule they set themselves, so the day can shift. Ask Guest Services or electronics which weekday the Excell card vendor comes. Limits are set company-wide, often 1-2 per item; Target.com drops mostly 3-6am ET.

Store Facebook: facebook.com/Walmart1887 (no Pokémon posts seen).

name: Pokémon Center (online)
notes: Drops on weekdays: Wed 33%, Tue 31%, Mon 23%, Thu 10%, Fri 3% (Restockd, 39 US releases since Jan 2025), late morning to early afternoon ET (roughly 11am-1:15pm). A queue opens first and product goes live about 13 minutes later. Delta Reign preorders weren't open as of Sep 7; 2026 lead times of 37-63 days point to about Sep 28-Oct 2 (a projection). Newsletter subscribers can get Early Access emails. Limits are per product (often 2), and bot orders get mass-cancelled.
